request: Analyze GSE278016 for PMID 41194654 (Anabolic Effects of Salbutamol Are Lost Upon Immobilization.): how exercise affects gene expression as the paper intends.

final.primary_estimand: Physical-activity (muscle contraction) contrast as the paper defines it: effect of 2-week unilateral hindlimb immobilization (disuse) on quadriceps transcriptome, immobilized right leg vs contralateral non-immobilized left leg of untreated caloric-restricted mice (S3.6.p1, FIG6A). Secondary: salbutamol effect in mobile vs immobilized legs (S3.6.p1-p2), and caloric restriction vs healthy reference (S3.6.p1). No exercise arm exists; disuse (removal of contraction) is the activity manipulation.
final.groups: 5 groups x n=15: H.0.0.R, CR.0.0.L, CR.I.0.R, CR.0.S.L, CR.I.S.R (S2.7.p1, FIG7)
final.repeated_measure_unit: mouse: CR mice contribute both legs (left non-immob, right immob) (S2.7.p1)
final.sample_inclusion: all 75 quadriceps samples (FIG7: n=15 per group)
planned_contrasts: CR+Immob untreated vs CR untreated non-immob (immobilization effect; paper 2241 genes, S3.6.p1)
CR untreated non-immob vs Healthy (caloric restriction; paper 6513 genes, S3.6.p1)
CR+Salbutamol non-immob vs CR untreated non-immob (salbutamol in mobile leg; paper 2904 genes, S3.6.p2)
CR+Immob+Salbutamol vs CR+Immob untreated (salbutamol in immobilized leg; paper count not stated directly; 281 overlap with IM genes, 518 overlap with 2904)

paper_threshold.source_locator: S2.11.p1 (DESeq2; pathways p < 0.01 only); S2.13.p1 general p < 0.05 for non-omics stats

final.paper_method: HTSeq-count -> DESeq2; GSEA on Reactome (pathway p < 0.01)
final.paper_results: IM 2241 DEGs; CR 6513; salbutamol non-immob 2904; 518 of those still significant in immobilized leg; muscle contraction pathway up by salbutamol in mobile leg only; Rac1 down in immobilized vs non-immobilized (log2FC -0.26)

paper_reconstruction.reasoning: Paper is a salbutamol x immobilization study; transcriptomics in S2.11.p1/S3.6. The only physical-activity contrast is immobilization (disuse) vs contralateral mobile leg, which the paper frames as removing muscle contraction (S4.p1). The paper never states the gene-level significance rule.

checks: GEO: mouse quadriceps, C57BL/6J, TNO contact, STAR+HTSeq-count vM19 matches S2.11.p1

ownership.reasoning: Data availability statement names GSE278016; processing and design match the paper.

alignment.reasoning: Matrix columns (105707-001-NNN) equal metadata 'description' exactly for 75/75. grp derived from the treatment code (diet.immob.compound.leg).

matrix.reasoning: 100% integers, max 2.76M; data_processing: HTSeq-count reads per gene, not normalised, input for DESeq2.

final.analysis_type: multi-group, one DESeq2 model on 5 groups with planned pairwise contrasts

candidates.value: characteristics_ch1.4.treatm.immob pooled (I vs 0 across all groups)
candidates.reason_rejected: pools salbutamol and healthy groups; paper's IM contrast is within untreated CR mice

candidates.value: 2x2 factorial immob x compound with interaction
candidates.reason_rejected: paper reports simple-effect contrasts (FIG6A/C/D), not an interaction test; simple effects from the 5-group model reproduce them

design.reasoning: Paper contrasts are simple effects between the 5 groups (FIG6). One model fitted on all samples; reference CR (untreated non-immobilized). Immobilization (CRI vs CR) is the primary activity contrast.

covariates.name: leg side (treatm.leg)
covariates.disposition: aliased with immobilization by design (immobilized leg is always right); not a separate covariate

covariates.name: mouse (pairing of left/right legs)
covariates.disposition: blocking would be appropriate but no mouse key is recorded in GEO; legs analyzed as independent samples (conservative for within-mouse contrasts)

covariance.reasoning: CR mice contributed both legs (S2.7.p1), so CRI vs CR and CRIS vs CRS are within-mouse. Sample numbers differ per leg (016-030 vs 076-090) and no mouse ID exists in metadata, so the pairing cannot be recovered without guessing by position, which is forbidden. Ignoring a positive within-mouse correlation inflates the variance of the difference (conservative), so the unpaired test remains valid. Leg side is the experimental contralateral-control design, not a nuisance variable.

deviations: no mouse blocking (key not deposited); paper's own blocking unknown

method.reasoning: Raw HTSeq counts; paper used DESeq2 (S2.11.p1).

final.deviation_note: Paper never states the gene-level rule; applied BH padj < 0.05 (workflow default). Raw p < 0.05 recorded only as an audit comparison because S2.13.p1 uses p < 0.05 for other outcomes.

threshold.reasoning: S2.11.p1 states only the pathway rule (p < 0.01); no gene threshold anywhere.

caveats: No exercise arm: the activity contrast is disuse (immobilization) vs mobile contralateral leg under caloric restriction; interpret as removal of muscle contraction, the inverse of loading.
Within-mouse pairing not modelled (no mouse key deposited).
Paper's gene-level threshold unstated; counts compared under workflow default.
Immobilized leg is always the right leg; side is aliased with immobilization.

discrepancies.data: no mouse identifier; left/right sample numbers in disjoint ranges
